name: own-names-bench v1.3 conversation test suite (held out, sealed)
suite_hash_rule: sha256 of SHA256SUMS: the sorted lines '<sha256>  <path relative to suite/>' of every file

build.recipe: lore-poc convdata (branch data/conv-names-v1, commit 9004fe4), see README.md

voxpopuli.what: European Parliament plenary speeches, English transcribed subset, test split; speaker ids

libritts.what: LibriTTS-R test-clean and test-other (restored LibriVox read speech)

fsd.licence: CC BY 4.0 (FSD50K); only clips whose own licence is CC0 1.0 or CC BY 3.0 (fsd_test.json)
fsd.what: FSD50K clips without speech or music, none used in train or dev and by no train/dev uploader: street and indoor/ambient background noise

meta.what: LibriSpeech SPEAKERS.TXT / CHAPTERS.TXT: reader names and LibriVox projects, for the reader and book exclusions

wav2vec2.what: CTC character model, used only to time the reference's words by forced alignment (no transcript is produced)

licence: CC BY 4.0 (suite annotations and processed audio); VoxPopuli CC0 1.0; LibriTTS-R CC BY 4.0; FSD50K CC BY 4.0 with clips CC0 1.0 / CC BY 3.0 (NOISE_ATTRIBUTION.csv per suite)
rule: Held out: scored once per final system (ours, ElevenLabs Scribe v2). No model or API was run on this audio while building it (the forced aligner timed reference words in prep). Do not train, tune, select or smoke-test on it.
